description:
Reproduction: create root capture handler that calls Core.stop_propagation and a child bubble handler; LiveComponent.handle_event invokes the child directly, bypassing capture. Filament.Test.dispatch_event does the same, so tests do not model LiveView behavior.
Instructions: route zero/one-arity handlers in both adapters through Core.dispatch_event. Preserve the LiveView socket-aware two-arity push path, stale-handler errors in the test API, and state-message flushing. Stop-propagation must be caught rather than escape as an uncaught throw.
Acceptance: same fixture through LiveView, LiveComponent, and Filament.Test proves root-to-parent capture order, suppression of the target when stopped, and normal target state updates when not stopped.
title: Use Core event dispatch in LiveComponent and the component test harness
